_note: Diagnosis taxonomy. Problem types are ordered: cheap, local explanations first; literature-heavy explanations last. Symptom patterns only propose candidates.

trivial_patterns.advice: Fix the syntax error; no literature search.

trivial_patterns.pattern: FileNotFoundError|No such file or directory|path does not exist

trivial_patterns.advice: Inspect the data structure / API version.

trivial_patterns.pattern: size mismatch|shape mismatch|mat1 and mat2 shapes cannot be multiplied|dimension mismatch
trivial_patterns.advice: Print tensor shapes at module boundaries.
Reduce batch size / use gradient accumulation / checkpointing; literature only if memory is a fundamental algorithmic bottleneck (then use mode=diagnose with symptom 'complexity bottleneck').

trivial_patterns.pattern: TypeError: .* got an unexpected keyword|unexpected keyword argument

problem_types.label: Implementation Bug
checks: Overfit a tiny batch (≤ 32 samples): loss should approach 0
Compare forward outputs against a reference implementation or the paper equations on a toy input
Check train/eval mode (dropout, batchnorm), detach/no_grad placement, loss reduction
Verify label/feature alignment after joins and shuffles (index mismatch)
Assert no NaN/Inf; check learning-rate schedule actually applied

problem_types.label: Data Processing Error
checks: Re-derive preprocessing from raw data for 3 random samples by hand
Check normalization fitted on train only (no test statistics leakage)
Check filtering removed the same features/entities in train and test
Verify identifiers (gene symbols vs Ensembl, genome build, species) are consistent
Run `cdri audit leakage` for group/duplicate/spatial leakage

problem_types.label: Evaluation Mismatch
checks: Recompute the metric at the paper's aggregation level (`cdri audit metric --group ...`)
Confirm the same split unit (entity-level vs sample-level) as the comparator
Confirm the baseline was run with the same protocol and a fair tuning budget
Check whether the comparator's reported number is on a different dataset version

problem_types.label: Optimization Failure
checks: Learning-rate range test; gradient-norm traces per module
Check loss scale between multi-task terms
Check for dead units / saturated activations / collapsed attention
Try a simpler optimizer setting known to work for the baseline

problem_types.label: Representation Failure
checks: Linear probe of learned representation for the target and for nuisance variables (batch, donor)
Check whether embeddings of unseen entities collapse to a common point
Compare against a fixed / random-feature representation

problem_types.label: Inductive Bias Mismatch
checks: List the model's assumptions (signature.required_assumptions) and test each on the data
Check whether the symmetry/invariance imposed actually holds
Ablate the inductive-bias module vs a neutral alternative with equal capacity

problem_types.label: Label Noise
checks: Estimate replicate concordance / noise ceiling
Inspect high-loss training samples for labeling artifacts
Check whether labels are proxies measured by a different assay

problem_types.label: Dataset Shift
checks: Two-sample test / classifier test between train and test features
Stratify errors by batch / site / donor / entity family
Check whether test entities are far from train entities in descriptor space

problem_types.label: Fundamental Identifiability Limitation
checks: Ask whether the supervision signal can in principle distinguish the hypotheses (two different mechanisms producing identical observations?)
Construct a synthetic dataset where the ground-truth mechanism is known and test recovery
Check whether the information needed for unseen entities is present in the inputs at all
